libretro-cap32 on Omarchy

Brings the classic Amstrad CPC home computer into RetroArch.

Package data synced 2026-10-19 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install libretro-cap32 on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add libretro-cap32-git. It is a 314.5 KB download (1.5 MB installed), version 1:4.5.4.r51.g4abfb8b-1, licensed GPL-2.0-or-later. Amstrad CPC core. Free and open source.

Install libretro-cap32 on Omarchy

This is Caprice32 packaged as a libretro core, letting RetroArch emulate the 1980s Amstrad CPC line of home computers, including the CPC 464, 464+, 6128, 6128+ and the GX4000 console variant. It plays original tape (CDT) and disk (DSK) images with autostart support, supports period keyboard layouts and joystick/lightgun input, and can use RetroArch's shaders for CRT-style visual effects. On its own it has no interface; it's a plugin loaded by RetroArch, which provides the actual on-screen menus.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add libretro-cap32-git
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1:4.5.4.r51.g4abfb8b-1:
    pacman -Qi libretro-cap32-git

Open and use libretro-cap32

libretro-cap32 has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql libretro-cap32-git | grep /usr/bin/

libretro-cap32 requirements and compatibility

  • RetroArch (or another libretro frontend) to actually run it
  • your own legally-owned Amstrad CPC game/software images, since none are bundled

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • glibc
  • libretro-core-info

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL-2.0-or-later.

Uninstall libretro-cap32

omarchy pkg drop libretro-cap32-git

Frequently asked questions

How do I install libretro-cap32 on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add libretro-cap32-git. The download is 314.5 KB and it takes 1.5 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is libretro-cap32 free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL-2.0-or-later.

How do I uninstall libretro-cap32?

Run omarchy pkg drop libretro-cap32-git. It removes the package from your system.

What does libretro-cap32 depend on?

The package declares 2 dependencies: glibc, libretro-core-info. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is libretro-cap32 a desktop app?

No. libretro-cap32 has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is libretro-cap32 in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as libretro-cap32-git (version 1:4.5.4.r51.g4abfb8b-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Libretro makes it. Project site: https://github.com/libretro/libretro-cap32.
